thread:
maria g: Quick kickoff — finalizing launch posts and webinar hook. Need keyword map + schema plan for webinar landing. Can we get a quick checksum on redirects and internal linking?

devon: I'm on keywords. Pushing seed keyword list to GDrive: https://drive.google.com/... Focus: "llm inference performance", "low-latency LLM API" and variations. :mag_right:

sam: For the webinar page we should add Event schema + FAQPage for common questions. Also add structured data for offers (if gated).

lee: Internal linking plan: add contextual links docs -> webinar -> launch posts. I'll create a 1:1 mapping CSV and hand to SEO ops.

ashley: Redirects: small set of legacy blog URLs need 301s to the new launch pages. Proposed nginx rule we can deploy to CDN edge: 
```
rewrite ^/old-launch/(.*)$ /launch/new/$1 permanent;
```
:eyes:

seo-bot: sitemap updated: /sitemap_launch.xml pushed. Crawl request queued.

maria g: Can someone craft 3 short benchmark narratives we can use for launch posts + webinar slides? Need CRO hooks + keyword alignment.

devon: I'll draft three: 
- Bench A: low-latency retrieval + user-perceived speed for search UX
- Bench B: cost-per-inference for 1M monthly queries (quantized model vs baseline)
- Bench C: tail-latency & reliability under concurrent bursts
Posting drafts by EOD.

sam: Quick QA note — ensure canonical tags on legacy pages are updated to point at /launch/new and remove any self-canonical on duplicates. hreflang not needed for en-only.

lee: Internal link anchor suggestions to use in the CSV: 
- low-latency inference
- Redwood API
- dedicated capacity
- production inference checklist

ashley: Redirect list (inline CSV) — will upload to the repo after review: 
old,new
/old-launch/ml-inference,/launch/new/ml-inference
/blog/fast-llm,/launch/new/fast-llm
/docs/deploy-legacy,/docs/deploy

maria g: Perfect. Also we need UTM template for all webinar CTAs so inbound routing into Marketo is clean. Proposed: 
utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=launch_q2

devon: noted. I'll append UTMs to all tracked links and run a quick SERP check next week to validate target KW choices.

lee: I'll open the internal-link PR once the CSV is approved. Tagging @sam for canonical/schema validation before merge.

sam: Added Event schema snippet for the landing (will paste into CMS render block): 
```
{
  "@context":"https://schema.org",
  "@type":"Event",
  "name":"Redwood Inference Launch Webinar",
  "startDate":"2026-04-14T10:00:00Z",
  "offers":{"@type":"Offer","url":"https://.../register","availability":"https://schema.org/InStock"}
}
```

maria g: :thumbsup: Closing ask — who owns final prelaunch checklist and the sitemap ping? @devon?

devon: I'll own checklist + final sitemap ping. Will confirm when submitted.

deploybot: sitemap: /sitemap_launch.xml submitted to Google Search Console (job 8823) — status: submitted.

maria g: thanks team — we'll sync 09:30 tomorrow to close outstanding items. /end
